task.claim:
For any type A with associative commutative addition and a two-sided zero,
define multiple r P by repeated addition. Let P,T:A and r:Nat. Suppose
there exists k:Nat with r=k+k+1, multiple r P=zero, T+T=zero and T!=zero.
Then multiple r (P+T)!=zero. More precisely multiple r (P+T)=T.
No concrete curve, factor base, or subgroup membership certificate is imported.
